text: こいつは　つかまりそうにないぞ！

structure.jp: つかまりそうにないぞ！
structure.en: doesn't look like it will get caught!

patterns.name: 〜そうにない
patterns.explanation: そうにない on a verb means it does not look like that will happen. つかまりそうにない = 'doesn't look like it will be caught'.

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end is a rough, strong way to push your point, like 'I tell you!'. つかまりそうにないぞ = 'it's not going to be caught, I tell you'.
